extracted.name: Chip Dip
extracted.description: A simple, delicious cream cheese dip for potato chips that gains flavor from freshly minced onion — no dry-soup packages required. Easy to make.
instruction_lines: Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, milk, and Worcestershire sauce in a small mixing bowl. Stir in onions to combine.
